summary: Implemented the builtin parameter glue as an unused method, ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults, in botocore/args.py. It maps region, endpoint URL, FIPS/dualstack, and S3 config (accelerate, path style, ARN region, multi-region access points) to AWS::/SDK:: builtin names. Added 11 unit tests in tests/unit/test_args.py. All 47 args tests pass. Related run of test_client, test_args, and test_session: 388 passed, 2 skipped, 1 failed (test_session.py::TestSessionComponent::test_internal_component, 'Unknown component: internal'). That failure is in session component handling, which I did not touch; I did not verify it against the original code. Nothing committed.
